title: The Masteriyo LMS – LMS Course Builder, Quizzes & Certificates plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object…
description: The Masteriyo LMS plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 3.5.1 is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection via deserialization of untrusted input in the course importer. This vulnerability arises because the set_post_metas() method unserializes attacker-controlled postmeta string values from uploaded JSON import files. Exploitation by unauthenticated attackers requires a non-default configuration where enable_instructor_registration and enable_guest_checkout are both true and at least one purchasable course exists. On default installations, exploitation requires author-level or higher privileges.
